dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 将来について悩んでます
dialogue.English: I've been struggling with my future.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それは大事な問題ですよね
dialogue.English: I see, that's a very important issue, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 将来とはどのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say your future, what specifically do you mean?

dialogue.content: いま大学四年生ですが、就活で迷いが出ています
dialogue.English: I'm a senior in college, and I'm feeling lost in my job search.

dialogue.content: それはとても大変な時期を迎えておられるのですね。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're going through a very challenging time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どういった点で迷っておられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In what ways are you feeling lost?

dialogue.content: 自分が経済学部で、とりあえず金融系の会社を受けているのですが、このままでいいのかな、って思います
dialogue.English: I'm an economics major, so I've been applying to companies in the financial sector for now, but I'm wondering if this is really the right path for me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね自分の専門性も生かしたいし、悩ましいですよね。。
dialogue.English: I understand. You want to make use of your specialization, so it's a difficult decision.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 金融系以外にも興味のある業界などがおありでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are there any industries besides finance that interest you?

dialogue.content: うーん、やりたいこともないし、よくわからなくて。ぼんやり不安です
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don't really have anything I want to do, and I'm not sure. I just feel vaguely anxious.

dialogue.content: それはなかなか決めるのは難しいですよね。。
dialogue.English: That must make it very difficult to make a decision.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学生時代はどのようなことをしてこられましたか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things have you been involved in during your student years?

dialogue.content: 勉強して、居酒屋でアルバイトをしてました
dialogue.English: I studied and worked part-time at a pub (izakaya).

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、学問にアルバイトにと忙しく頑張ってこられたのですね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you worked hard, keeping busy with your studies and your part-time job.

dialogue.content: 忙しく…かはわかりませんが、みんなと同じようにやってました。
dialogue.English: I don't know if I was 'busy,' but I was doing the same as everyone else.

dialogue.content: 就活についてどなたかに相談されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken to anyone about your job search?

dialogue.content: 特にないです。
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: ご自身で懸命に頑張られているのですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been working very hard on this on your own.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: I guess so...

dialogue.content: 就活は始められてどれくらいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been job hunting?

dialogue.content: 4ヶ月くらいです
dialogue.English: About four months.

dialogue.content: 4ヶ月頑張ってこられたんですね
dialogue.English: So you've been working at it for four months.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 就職活動をされて4ヶ月であれば、慣れてきて色々と自分なりに考えが出てくる時期なのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Having been job hunting for four months, perhaps you're at a stage where you're getting used to it and starting to have various thoughts of your own.

dialogue.content: そうですね、そうかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Yes, that might be the case.

dialogue.content: 経済学部であれば、金融以外にもメーカー、商社など幅広く対応できそうにも思いますが、ご自身ではどうお考えですか？
dialogue.English: As an economics major, it seems you could apply to a wide range of fields besides finance, like manufacturing or trading companies. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: なんか…こう。自分のやりたいことがなさすぎて、どこ受けても多分不安だと思うんです。
dialogue.English: Well... it's like, I don't really have anything I want to do, so I think I'd feel anxious no matter where I apply.

dialogue.content: やりたいことが見つからず、就活続けていくのはとても辛いですよね。。
dialogue.English: It must be very tough to continue job hunting without knowing what you want to do.

dialogue.content: なんかこのままでいいのかなーって、漠然と不安になるんですよね。
dialogue.English: I just get this vague anxiety, wondering if it's okay to just continue like this.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: かといって今更な気もします。とりあえず就活しないとって感じで。
dialogue.English: But at the same time, it feels too late to change. I just feel like I have to keep job hunting for now.

dialogue.content: 「このままでいいのか？」というのは何かやり残した感じとかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say, 'Is it okay to continue like this?', do you mean it feels like you've left something undone?

dialogue.content: 目標ややりたいこともないまま社会に出て、仕事を続けていけるのかなって思います。
dialogue.English: I wonder if I can enter the workforce and continue working without any goals or things I want to do.

dialogue.content: 今の自分のような感じで本当に大丈夫かな？と思うと不安が大きくなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: The anxiety grows when you think, 'Will I really be okay as I am now?', doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大学での勉強自体はどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: How were your studies at university?

dialogue.content: 可もなく不可もなくって感じでした。楽しくはないけど、普通の成績でした。
dialogue.English: They were okay, I guess. Not particularly enjoyable, but I got average grades.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、学生生活をしっかり続けれてこられたのですね
dialogue.English: I see. You've been able to keep up with your studies consistently.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を少し整理してよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 現在就活中で、経済学部のため金融関係を受けておられます
dialogue.English: You're currently job hunting, and because you're an economics major, you're applying for jobs in the financial sector.

dialogue.content: ただ、自分のやりたいことがなく、このままつづけていていいのか？悩んでおられます
dialogue.English: However, you don't have anything specific you want to do, and you're worried about whether it's okay to continue on this path.

dialogue.content: これまでの学生時代は、勉強、アルバイトと頑張ってこられました。
dialogue.English: During your student years, you've worked hard at both your studies and your part-time job.

dialogue.content: 自分のやりたことがないまま就職しても本当に続けて行けるのかどうか、このまま就職してしまっていいのか？とても悩んでおられます
dialogue.English: You're very concerned about whether you can really continue working if you get a job without knowing what you want to do, and whether it's okay to get a job like this.

dialogue.content: このようなお話と思いますが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that an accurate summary?

dialogue.content: はい、そんな感じです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's about right.

dialogue.content: 感じたことを少しお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I share a few of my impressions?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: 勉強にアルバイトにとてもしっかりとした学生生活を過ごされているように感じました。
dialogue.English: I felt that you've led a very solid student life, balancing your studies and your part-time job.

dialogue.content: 成績も可もなく不可もなくということでしたが、これは継続して続けていける力のあるお方だなあと感じました。
dialogue.English: You mentioned your grades were average, but I feel that shows you have the strength to persevere and see things through.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 一方で、やりたいことが無いということで悩んでおられますが、これはそれだけご自身の将来について真剣に考えているからこそそうなるのではないかと思いました
dialogue.English: On the other hand, you're worried about not having something you want to do, but I think that's precisely because you are thinking so seriously about your own future.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 就活という大切な時期を迎えて不安になっておられますが、ご自身の将来のことを真剣に考えるとても有意義な時間を過ごされているともいえるのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: You're feeling anxious during this important time of job hunting, but couldn't we also say that you're spending this time in a very meaningful way, thinking seriously about your future?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこでご提案なのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: With that in mind, may I make a suggestion?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 少し視点を変えて、このせっかくの機会に色々な人の話を聞いてみるというのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about changing your perspective a little and using this valuable opportunity to talk to a variety of people?

dialogue.content: 色々な人って、どんな人でしょうか
dialogue.English: A variety of people? Like who?

dialogue.content: 例えば、今受けている金融関係だけではなくて、少し別の業界のセミナーを受けてみるとか、OB訪問をしてみるかとか、あと学校に就職課みたいな学生の就活をサーポートするところはありますか？
dialogue.English: For example, instead of just focusing on the financial sector you're applying to now, you could try attending a seminar for a different industry, or visiting some alumni. Also, does your university have a career services office or something similar that supports students with job hunting?

dialogue.content: そうですね、学生課があります。
dialogue.English: Yes, we have a student affairs office.

dialogue.content: 相談して、答えが見つかるでしょうか。
dialogue.English: If I talk to them, will I find an answer?

dialogue.content: 聞かれても、自分でもわからないのに…不安です。
dialogue.English: I'm worried because I don't even know myself, so what if they ask me questions...

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですよね
dialogue.English: That's certainly understandable.

dialogue.content: 分からないのにどうしたらいいの。。という感じですよね
dialogue.English: You feel like, 'I don't know, so what am I supposed to do?' right?

dialogue.content: 答えはそう簡単に見つからないかもしれません。
dialogue.English: You might not find an answer that easily.

dialogue.content: ただ、今は一人で探求を深めておられるところですが、
dialogue.English: But right now, you're exploring this all on your own.

dialogue.content: ここで一つ他者からの意見を聞いてみるというのも一つかと思いました何か聞かれて困るというより、必要なヒントをもらいに行く感じです
dialogue.English: So I thought that hearing opinions from others could be one option. It's less about being put on the spot with questions and more about going to get some necessary hints.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうすることで、今の自分から少し前進できるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By doing so, don't you think you could move forward a little from where you are now?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: 詳しい人に、いろいろ聞いてみようと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'll try talking to people who know more about these things.

dialogue.content: 学生の時代はなかなかやりたいことが見つからないかもしれませんが、就職して仕事をしながら見つけていく、自分をつくっていくという考え方もあると思います
dialogue.English: It can be hard to find what you want to do when you're a student, but I think there's also the approach of finding it and shaping yourself while you work after you get a job.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やりたいことが決まっている人って、そんなに多くはないのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I wonder if there are really that many people who have already decided what they want to do?

dialogue.content: なんか皆はそれぞれ就活で頑張ってるように見えて。それも辛いです。
dialogue.English: It just seems like everyone else is working so hard at their job search. That's hard for me too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、周りがとても頑張っているように見えますよね。。
dialogue.English: I understand. It really can seem like everyone around you is working so hard.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ！あなたもこれまで4ヶ月も一人で自分と向き合って頑張ってこられたのですよ是非そんな自分を褒めてあげてください！
dialogue.English: It's okay! You've also been working hard, facing this on your own for four months. Please give yourself credit for that!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。前向きに考えますね
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll try to think more positively.

dialogue.content: きっと、このまま前進していって就職していけば、きっと持ち前の継続していく力を発揮してその中でやりたいことも見つかってくるのではないかと私は感じましたがいかがですか
dialogue.English: I feel that if you keep moving forward and find a job, you'll be able to use your inherent strength to persevere, and you'll find what you want to do along the way. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね、とりあえず周りの人の話を聞いて、視野を広げようと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, for now, I'll try talking to people and broaden my horizons.

dialogue.content: はい、是非このご自身にとって大切な時期を自分を深める時期と思って楽しんで取り組んでみてください
dialogue.English: Yes, please try to embrace this important time as a period for self-discovery and even enjoy the process.

dialogue.content: 心から応援しております！
dialogue.English: I'm sincerely cheering for you!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日のご相談終了したいと思いますがよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: I think we can conclude our session for today. Is that alright with you?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそどうも有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.
